notes.title: NEW GAME: Hollow Memories
notes.notes:
Hey. Huli here! Check out my upcoming game!

Hollow Memories is daily life simulation game. You recently moved back to your hometown to find a job. After moving into a suspiciously cheap apartment, you find out that it's haunted by a pair of sexy ghosts, and you're stuck with them until the curse is broken. With the help of a small spirit, discover a way to break the curse, and help the ghosts move on by filling their hollow memories.

Remember to WISHLIST the game! Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442740/Hollow_Memories/

notes.title: About achievements
notes.notes: Hi, Huli here. For those who care about achievements, they're not working yet. The current stable release of Ren'Py apparently has a bug that stops Steam achievements from working. I'll update the game as soon as there's a new stable release of Ren'Py. Thanks!

notes.title: Housemates is NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes: Housemates is a daily life simulation game. A lust virus has hit the world! Play as a college student stuck inside with his landlady and housemate. Talk to them, get to know them, and importantly, 'help them out' with the lust virus! Two milfs with over 70 animated scenes to unlock!
